{{Top|leg}}
'''Comm cables''' were used for private communications from building to building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. [[Cartann City]] was littered with possibly millions of them, clustered at various altitudes with wide gaps between them so that [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] may pass through easily.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
